articles.title: Belgian Salmonella outbreak climbs to 300 cases
articles.description: In the initial incident, Salmonella was found in a dust sample taken from a Laerco chicken coop and subsequent analysis revealed it was the same type detected in patients.

articles.title: Jalapenos recalled from Costco stores because of Salmonella
articles.description: Dairyland Produce LLC, dba Hardie’s Fresh Foods of Houston, TX, and Dallas, TX, are recalling PEPPER JALAPENO 5#, because it has the potential to be contaminated with Salmonella.
